5074.name: coarea derivative map
5074.local_chart: For an opposite-pair chart with q+1 geodesics, a binary cohomology class induces a cut of K_{q+1}; if the smaller side has size s then the local apartment weight is s(q+1-s).
5074.active_chart_bound_reduction: A(x)>=4q^3 for every nonzero class implies wt(x)>=q^4
5074.boundary: The all-q inequality A(x)>=4q^3 remains open.

5075.assumption: every active chart is a minimum 1|4 cut
5075.satisfiable_supports: exactly the eight chamber stars through the fixed apartment
5075.consequence: Any non-chamber weight-256 word must contain at least one 2|3 chart.
5075.heavy_chart_parameterization: If A2=2t is the number of 2|3 charts, then A1=256-3t and A_active=256-t.
5075.boundary: Complete q=4 minimum-shell classification remains open only in the heavy-chart sector.

5076.boundary: This identifies the common quadratic order/lattice. No geometric PSp intertwiner is claimed because the historical transfer recurrence was not supplied with such an action.

5077.boundary: No global optimum among all denominator-780 raw bases is claimed.

5078.name: all-q Tanner six-cycle law
5078.root_triangle_classification: Every apartment-point triangle is either the three apartments from one theta triple, or three apartments sharing one common length-4 root.
5078.proof_count: There are q^3(q+1)^2(q^2+1) roots; for each root choose 3 of the q complementary roots, giving C(q,3).

5079.name: discrete derivative / root-sheet decomposition
5079.statement: For a chamber star of q^4 apartments, the active opposite-pair charts split into four role families of q^3 charts each, hence 4q^3 in total.
5079.interpretation: This is a discrete coarea/codimension-one derivative, not an infinitesimal derivative in the prime-power parameter q.

5080.name: noncommutative discrete Hessian
5080.interpretation: Second-direction composition is anisotropic: root directions do not form a Cartesian F_q^4 grid; commutator growth creates q^3 and q^4 closures.
5080.boundary: The Hessian terminology is an analogy for finite differences/root commutators, not differential calculus.

5081.name: chamber-star switch graph is non-Hamming
5081.interpretation: The derivative has four root directions, but the local carrier is curved/non-Cartesian rather than an ordinary 4-dimensional Hamming cube.
